mechanism.non_test_consumer: existing SearchLoopRunner.run now calls create_service and public ask/tell around its actual paired benchmark evaluator/ChampionRegistry
mechanism.fresh_reader: SearchLoopRunner.resume creates a fresh service, restores complete envelope and continues pending candidates before new generation
mechanism.rollback: malformed checkpoint refuses before state/generator admission; failed tell retains pending ownership and rolls back in-memory controller ledger; external registry/checkpoint effects have distinct atomic boundaries
mechanism.reader_window: known version only; unknown schema/configuration fails closed; old in-memory instances have no artifact to migrate
mechanism.import_boundary: actual normal root-facade and package contract imports are lazy; runtime controller/funnel/Torch import trap passes; internal child modules are not newly registered stable surfaces

limitations: Appointed served hierarchical caller/input remains a separate missing owner packet; no served cutover/rollback claim.
